title: Snapshot encoding
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet and let $s$ be one of its snapshots. Encode $s$ by a Boolean list of length equal to the number of possible snapshots, with a $1$ at the position corresponding to $s$ and $0$ at every other position.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet
